name: Creator
author: PyCmd
description: A tab of its own where code is built out of blocks instead of typed. Over three hundred and sixty blocks across Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Markdown, and every row - in the palette and in your script - is the line that block actually writes, so the screen is the code rather than a description of it. Each language keeps its own script. Press See the code for the whole file, and Save as a file to put it in your workspace, where the editor opens it, the Servers tab runs it and the Pages tab serves it.
